description: Create a post for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, etc. Supports text copy, image attachments (single or multi-image gallery), and video. For image-only or video-only posts, body can be left empty as long as mediaIds has at least one asset. Without scheduledAt it is saved as a draft. With scheduledAt (ISO 8601) it is scheduled.

body.description: Post copy text (optional if mediaIds is provided)

channelIds.description: Destination channel UUIDs or platform names (e.g. ['linkedin', 'instagram'])

mediaIds.description: Array of media asset UUIDs returned by import_media or list_media

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp to schedule the post (e.g. '2026-09-21T11:00:00Z'). Without this, saves as a draft.

name: create_post

outputSchema.description: Created post draft or queue entry

title: Create post
